Cell.Data: Identifies the specification of content and rules that apply to the transaction.
Identifies the BII profile or business process context in which the transaction appears.

An transaction instance must contain an identifier. The identifier enables positive referencing the document instance for various purposes including referencing between transactions that are part of the same process.
The date when this version of the Manifest is issued. Format = "YYYY-MM-DD".
The time when this version of the Manifest is issued. Format = "hh:mm:ss".

A code signifying the type of Manifest, e.g. cargo manifest, crew list, passenger list or ship's/aircraft's stores declaration. Must be part of UNCL1001 (restricted to the subset relevant for Manifest - see structure/codelist/UNCL1001_T131.xml).
The type of Manifest expressed as free text, used when the type cannot be, or is not, expressed by ManifestTypeCode.
The version of this Manifest. Used for maintaining updated versions of the same Manifest.
An indication that the goods declared in this Manifest are subject to an ad valorem duty, i.e. a duty calculated as a percentage of the declared value of the goods (true), or not (false).
The value of the goods declared for carriage. Used as the basis for calculating any ad valorem duty when AdValoremIndicator is true.
The party issuing the Manifest. Normally the Logistics Operator that operates, or arranges the operation of, the means of transport (vessel, aircraft, truck or wagon) that the Manifest describes.
An identifier for the end point of the routing service for the Sending Logistics Operator party (e.g., EAN Location Number, GLN).
An identifier for the Sending Logistics Operator party.
The name of the Sending Logistics Operator party.
The postal address of the Sending Logistics Operator party.
The main address line in a postal address usually the street name and number.
An additional address line in a postal address that can be used to give further details supplementing the main line.
The common name of the city where the postal address is.
The identifier for an addressable group of properties according to the relevant national postal service.
For specifying a region, county, state, province etc. within a country by using text.
A code that identifies the country, according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
The name of the Sending Logistics Operator party.
Sending Logistics Operator parties legal registration ID
The official identifier of the party as registered with the relevant fiscal authority.
The identification scheme identifier of the Sending Logistics Operator legal registration identifier
The contact of the Sending Logistics Operator party.
The phone number of the contact.
The electronic mail of the contact.
A public body (e.g. customs, port state control, terminal control) that requires this Manifest before, during or after a journey, in order to control cargo, crew and/or passengers.
An identifier for the end point of the routing service for the Authority party (e.g., EAN Location Number, GLN).
An identifier for the Authority party.
The name of the Authority party.
The postal address of the Authority.
The main address line in a postal address usually the street name and number.
The common name of the city where the postal address is.
The identifier for an addressable group of properties according to the relevant national postal service.
A code that identifies the country, according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
The contact of the Authority party.
The phone number of the contact.
The electronic mail of the contact.
The party sending the goods described in the Manifest's shipment.
An identifier for the Consignor party.
The name of the Consignor party.
The postal address of the Consignor party.
The main address line in a postal address usually the street name and number.
The common name of the city where the postal address is.
The identifier for an addressable group of properties according to the relevant national postal service.
A code that identifies the country, according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
The name of the Consignor party.
The official identifier of the party as registered with the relevant fiscal authority.
The identification scheme identifier of the Consignor legal registration identifier
The contact of the Consignor party.
The phone number of the contact.
The electronic mail of the contact.
The party to whom the goods described in the Manifest's shipment are addressed.
An identifier for the Consignee party.
The name of the Consignee party.
The postal address of the Consignee party.
The main address line in a postal address usually the street name and number.
An additional address line in an address that can be used to give further details supplementing the main line.
The common name of the city where the postal address is.
The identifier for an addressable group of properties according to the relevant national postal service.
A code that identifies the country, according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
The contact of the Consignee party.
The phone number of the contact.
The electronic mail of the contact.
A crew member of the means of transport (vessel or aircraft) that the Manifest describes. Repeat for each crew member declared.
The crew member's job title / function on board (e.g. Captain, First Officer, Purser).
A code that identifies the crew member's nationality, according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
Reference to an identity document for the crew member, e.g. a passport or seaman's book.
The ID of the identity document, for instance a passport number.
A passenger carried on the means of transport (vessel or aircraft) that the Manifest describes. Repeat for each passenger declared.
A code that identifies the passenger's nationality, according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
Reference to an identity document for the passenger, e.g. a passport.
The ID of the identity document, for instance a passport number.

The shipment carried by the means of transport that this Manifest describes. Kept lean by design: the Manifest does not repeat the full goods-item level detail of the underlying Waybill, it summarizes the consignment and refers to the Waybill for full detail (see cac:DocumentReference below).
Identifies the shipment described by this Manifest. If this ID is in the GSIN format, it should be indicated in the attribute @schemeID.
Free-form text pertinent to this shipment, conveying information that is not contained explicitly in other structures.
The consignment, forming part of the shipment described by this Manifest, that this Manifest declares.
If this ID is in the GINC format, it should be indicated in the attribute @schemeID. This is the same consignment as declared on the referenced Waybill.
Consignment identifier assigned by the consignee
Consignment identifier assigned by the consignor
The gross weight of the consignment as declared on the Manifest. Should match the gross weight declared on the referenced Waybill.
The gross volume of the consignment as declared on the Manifest. Should match the gross volume declared on the referenced Waybill.
Total number of transport handling units
The total number of transport handling units in this consignment

Reference to the Waybill that covers this consignment in full detail (parties, goods items, hazardous items, transport handling units etc.). This reference is mandatory for every Consignment declared in a Manifest under this profile: the Manifest itself is deliberately kept lean and relies on the Waybill for the complete data set.
The cbc:ID of the referenced Waybill.
The type of reference. Must be part of UNCL1001. Use the transport-mode-specific code where known (e.g. 740 Air waybill, 710 Sea waybill, 703 House waybill), or the generic 700 Waybill otherwise.
The type of reference that cannot be specified by a code alone.

Reference to other documents relevant for this Manifest as a whole (as opposed to a single consignment), for example a Master Air Waybill covering several house waybills/consignments consolidated on the same flight.
The reference number of the added document
The type of reference. Must be part of UNCL1001.
The type of reference that cannot be specified by a code
Group to describe an attached document. An attachment can refer to an external document or be included with the document being exchanged.
A reference to an attached document that is external to the document(s) being exchanged.
The Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) that identifies the external object as an Internet resource.
Describes the distribution of a copy of this Manifest to an interested party other than the Authority named in cac:AuthorityParty, e.g. the cargo terminal handling the shipment.
An identifier for this document distribution.
The type of distribution, expressed as text.
The interested party who receives a copy of this Manifest.
The name of the receiving party.
The postal address of the receiving party.
The common name of the city where the postal address is.
A code that identifies the country, according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
The contact of the receiving party.
The electronic mail of the contact.
A signature applied to this Manifest, typically by the Authority to confirm receipt/acceptance, or by the Sending Logistics Operator to attest the declaration.
The date upon which this signature was verified. Format = "YYYY-MM-DD".
The local time at which this signature was verified. Format = "hh:mm:ss".
The name of the Signature party.
The postal address of the Signature Party
The main address line in a postal address usually the street name and number.
The common name of the city where the postal address is.
A code that identifies the country, according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
The person who applies the signature on behalf of the Signature Party.
The actual signature included or referred to as an attachment.
A reference to an attached document that is external to the document(s) being exchanged.
The Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) that identifies the external object as an Internet resource.
